source.custom: Backgrounds: feat only, no ASI (2026-11-06 ruling).

system.description:
Entertainer

You thrived in front of an audience, knowing how to entrance them, entertain them, and even inspire them. Your poetics can stir the hearts of those who hear you, awakening grief or joy, laughter or anger. Your music raises their spirits or captures their sorrow. Your dance steps captivate, your humor cuts to the quick. Whatever techniques you used; your art is your life.

Skill Proficiencies: Acrobatics, Performance

Tool Proficiencies: Disguise kit

Equipment: A Love letter from someone you used to be close to, A Costume from an event prior.

Equipment Pack: Infiltrator’s or Captain’s Pack (Choose one).

Feature: Back by popular Demand

You can always find a place to perform, and performance earns you more than applause. In any settlement with an inn, entertainment district, or public venue you can secure free lodging and a meal in exchange for an evening's entertainment. After spending one evening performing in a location, the GM reveals one piece of relevant local information, rumor, or secret to you, as people speak freely around the entertainment.

Enticing Personality

Gain a General or Skill feat from Chapter 13 (Recommended: Any Charisma based Skill Feat)
